SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE) AS today_reservations,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_inquiries WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS')) AS open_inquiries,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_time_slots s JOIN ticket_product_options o ON o.ticket_product_option_id = s.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_products p ON p.ticket_product_id = o.ticket_product_id JOIN ticket_inventory i ON i.ticket_time_slot_id = s.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND o.is_active = TRUE AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND i.total_quantity - i.reserved_quantity <= #{lowStockThreshold}) AS low_stock_slots
